description: Our latest published news items, newest first. Each item has title, our own summary, published_at, source_name and source_url (we link to the original; no third-party article text is returned), permalink, url, linked companies, the linked funding round (amount as announced, never converted) or fund, and is_breaking. Arguments (all optional): since (ISO 8601 time; only items published after it), topic (topic slug, see list_topics), country (slug or ISO code), story_type ('funding' | 'fund-close'), limit (default 20, max 50). Unknown arguments are rejected.

country.description: Country as a slug ('italy') or a two-letter ISO code ('IT'); case-insensitive.

since.description: ISO 8601 time; only items published after it, e.g. 2026-11-15T08:00:00Z.

story_type.description: Only funding-round stories or fund-close stories.

name: get_latest_news
title: Latest fintech news
